_comment: Branch ruleset for `main`, kept in the repo so the protection is reviewable and
reproducible instead of living only in the GitHub UI. Apply it with:
bypass_actors gives RepositoryRole 5 (admin) an 'always' bypass, so the maintainer can
merge without waiting for checks. Everyone else still goes through the full gate.
required_approving_review_count is 0 on purpose: GitHub does not let you approve your
own pull request, so on a single-maintainer repo any higher number blocks every merge.
codecov/patch and codecov/project are NOT required here yet. Uploads work (CODECOV_TOKEN
is set) but the statuses are posted by the Codecov GitHub App, which is not installed —
so a required check on them would never report. Once the app is installed at
https://github.com/apps/codecov and both statuses show up on a PR, add these two entries
name: Protect main
